verses.raw: O you who have believed, it is not lawful for you to inherit women by compulsion.<sup foot_note=254179>1</sup> And do not make difficulties for them in order to take [back] part of what you gave them<sup foot_note=254180>2</sup> unless they commit a clear immorality [i.e., adultery]. And live with them in kindness. For if you dislike them - perhaps you dislike a thing and Allāh makes therein much good.
verses.text: O you who have believed, it is not lawful for you to inherit women by compulsion. And do not make difficulties for them in order to take [back] part of what you gave them unless they commit a clear immorality [i.e., adultery]. And live with them in kindness. For if you dislike them - perhaps you dislike a thing and Allāh makes therein much good.
